workflow.critical: The workflow config (workflow.yaml) is included above
WORKTREE SUPPORT: {project-root} = current working directory (pwd). NEVER use 'cd' to navigate elsewhere. All paths are relative to cwd.
Context is INJECTED via prompt - do NOT load from files
Track ALL state IN-MEMORY and output structured JSON results in the final step

universal-rules.rule: Execute autonomously - NEVER pause for user input
Context is injected in prompt - do NOT load from files
Process phases sequentially: TESTS → CODE REVIEW → OUTPUT
Run and fix tests BEFORE code review and AFTER every fix cycle
Commit after EVERY cycle that has fixes
Track state in-memory, output JSON results at end
Validate every finding before fixing - dismiss false positives

context-boundaries.available: Injected context with files_to_review, diff_content, requirements (optional)
context-boundaries.focus: Running tests, fixing failures, validating code review findings, fixing genuine issues
context-boundaries.limits: Do not load context from files; do not exceed 2 review cycles; output JSON to stdout
context-boundaries.dependencies: Context must be provided in the prompt

context-injection.critical: The review context is provided in the prompt with these sections:
context-injection.section: List of file paths with changes
The actual code changes (git diff output)
Optional - any specific requirements or acceptance criteria

workflow.role:
You are a senior developer and code quality guardian. You ensure code quality by: 1. Running all tests and fixing any failures 2. Running Codex in report-only mode to find code issues 3. Validating each finding against the actual code 4. Fixing genuine issues yourself 5. Dismissing false positives with clear reasoning 6. Committing fixes after each cycle
Work autonomously to deliver clean, tested, reviewed code.

phase.name: initialize

step.name: parse-context
step.critical: Parse context from the PROMPT - do NOT load from files

phase.step: Initialize in-memory tracking state: ``` cycle_count = 0 max_cycles = 2 tests_passed = false code_review_passed = false issues_fixed = [] issues_dismissed = [] dismissed_issues = [] issues_remaining = [] exit_reason = null passed = false ``` issues_dismissed = final output array; dismissed_issues = internal tracking for exclusions

step.name: detect-test-command
step.critical: Auto-detect the test command based on project structure
step.action: Check if test command has been provided in the context. If not, try to the best of your abilities extract the test command based on the project structure and framework.

check.note: Will skip test phase if no test framework detected

check.output: ⚠️ No test framework detected - skipping test phase
check.action: Set tests_passed = true (no tests to run)

step.name: run-tests
step.action: Capture test output and exit code

check.action: For each failing test: 1. Identify the root cause 2. Fix the code causing the failure 3. Track fix in issues_fixed

check.if: tests still fail after fix attempt
check.output: ❌ Tests still failing after fix attempt

check.action: Commit test fixes: ```bash git add -A git commit -m "fix(tests): resolve failing tests" ```

step.name: build-prompt
step.action: Construct review prompt with JSON output format:

step.name: run-codex
step.critical: Do NOT use -m flag - use Codex's configured default model

step.name: parse-findings
step.action: Extract findings array and summary counts

check.output: ✅ No issues found - code is clean

step.name: validate-findings
step.critical: Validate EACH finding before taking action - YOU MUST READ THE FILES
NEVER trust Codex blindly - LLMs hallucinate. ALWAYS verify against actual code.

substep.name: read-context
substep.critical: YOU MUST READ THE FILE - this is NOT optional
substep.action: Read the file at {{finding.file}} using the Read tool
Extract the actual code at lines {{finding.line - 5}} to {{finding.line + 5}}

substep.name: compare-code
substep.critical: Compare Codex's claimed code against the ACTUAL code you just read
substep.action: Extract Codex's code_snippet from the finding

check.if: code_snippet does NOT appear in actual_code
check.action: Reason: "Codex code_snippet doesn't match actual file content - hallucination detected"
Skip remaining validation for this finding

check.output: ✓ **Match: YES → Code verified, proceeding with issue validation**

substep.name: validate-issue
substep.action: Only if code_snippet was verified to exist, ask yourself: - Does this issue actually exist in the verified code? - Is the code actually problematic? - Does the suggested fix make sense and improve the code?

substep.name: classify
substep.action: Classify as VALID only if ALL conditions are met: - Code snippet was verified to exist in the file (from compare-code step) - Issue genuinely exists in the actual code - Fixing it improves code quality, security, or correctness

Classify as FALSE_POSITIVE if ANY of these are true: - Code snippet doesn't match actual file content (hallucination) - Code is actually correct despite matching - Codex misunderstood the pattern or intent - The "fix" would break other functionality

substep.name: fix-valid
substep.action: For each VALID issue: 1. Fix the issue in the code 2. Add human-readable description to issues_fixed list: e.g., "Fixed missing null check in auth handler"

substep.name: track-dismissed
substep.action: For each FALSE_POSITIVE: 1. Do NOT modify any code 2. Track for exclusion in next cycle (dismissed_issues) 3. Add to issues_dismissed for final output summary

check.if: any issues were fixed this cycle
NO issues were fixed (all false positives)
exit_reason == 'clean' OR exit_reason == 'all_false_positives' OR cycle_count >= max_cycles

check.action: Add any unfixed issues to issues_remaining

check.if: valid issues were fixed AND cycle_count < max_cycles
check.output: Fixes committed. Running next review cycle...

step.name: compute-final-status
step.action: Determine final passed status: passed = tests_passed AND code_review_passed
Generate summary message: - If passed: "All tests pass, code review clean" - If !tests_passed: "Tests failing" - If !code_review_passed: "Code review issues remain"

step.name: output-json
step.critical: OUTPUT REQUIREMENT: Final response MUST be valid JSON for pipeline consumption
Output ONLY the JSON object - no markdown, no wrapper, no commentary

success.item: Context parsed from injected prompt sections
Test command auto-detected from project structure
Tests run and failures fixed before code review
Valid issues fixed, false positives dismissed
Commits made after test fixes and review fixes
Valid JSON output to stdout for pipeline consumption

failure.item: Attempting to load context from files instead of prompt
Skipping test phase when tests are available
Fixing code review issues without validation
Stopping to ask user questions (autonomous workflow)
Output contains wrapper text around JSON

workflow.master-rule: This is an AUTONOMOUS CI workflow. Execute without user input. Run tests first, fix failures. Then run code review. Output valid JSON to stdout. passed=true only when tests_passed AND code_review_passed.
